question: Motion to Concur in the House Amendment to the Senate Amendment to H.R. 6644 with an Amendment (SA 5823)
plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act (H.R. 6644) establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote was on accepting the House's changes to the bill with a further Senate amendment (S.Amdt. 5823), which sends it back to the House. A Yea agrees to that step; a Nay opposes it.

question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: Motion to Concur in the House Amendment to the Senate Amendment to H.R. 6644 with an Amendment (SA 5823)
result: Cloture Motion Agreed to (84-8, 3/5 majority required)
plain_language: This vote would end debate on H.R. 6644 (21st Century ROAD to Housing Act), which establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. Cloture needs 60 votes (three-fifths of the Senate). A Yea limits debate so the Senate can move toward a final vote; a Nay keeps debate open.

question: Motion to Proceed to House Message to Accompany H.R. 6644
plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up H.R. 6644 (21st Century ROAD to Housing Act), which establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.
